events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his death in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: Still electrifying audiences decades on. What's your go-to Jimi track?

events.title: Abbey Road's Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: That iconic cover, those legendary tracks. What's your favourite moment from Abbey Road?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Still rocking and rolling at 75! Happy Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Still got that swagger! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message that still resonates. Celebrating the 'Imagine' album.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? The device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' changed everything!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the UK release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering music icon John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: A true visionary who changed music forever. Thinking of John Lennon on his birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a master of British comedy. Happy 87th Birthday, John Cleese!

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: An ambitious, experimental masterpiece. Celebrating 58 years of The Beatles' 'White Album'.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: A voice and a stage presence like no other. Forever remembering the legend that was Freddie Mercury.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. Celebrating the enduring brilliance of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering music icon John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lasting Impact
angles.copy: His music and message continue to inspire. Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing.
